title: 30-Day Return Policy
content: Customers can return unused items in original packaging within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Return shipping is free for damaged or incorrect items. For change-of-mind returns, a flat $5.99 return shipping label fee is deducted from the refund.

title: Non-Returnable Items
content: Intimate apparel, opened hygiene products, perishable goods, and customized or personalized items are strictly non-returnable unless defective upon arrival.

title: Standard and Express Shipping
content: Standard domestic shipping takes 3 to 5 business days and is free on orders over $50 ($4.99 otherwise). Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days at $14.99. International shipping takes 7 to 14 business days depending on customs clearance.

title: Lost or Damaged Packages
content: If your tracking shows delivered but you haven't received the package, please wait 24 hours. If it still does not arrive, contact support within 7 days of the marked delivery date for a replacement or full refund.

title: Accepted Payment Methods
content: We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Klarna pay-in-4 installments. All transactions are encrypted via 256-bit SSL.

title: Refund Processing Times
content: Once your return is inspected and approved at our warehouse, refunds are processed within 3 to 5 business days. The funds will reflect on your original payment method depending on your bank's billing cycle (typically 5 to 10 business days).

title: 1-Year Limited Manufacturer Warranty
content: All electronics and hardware products are covered by a 1-year limited warranty against hardware defects in materials and workmanship. The warranty does not cover accidental water damage, drops, unauthorized repairs, or normal cosmetic wear and tear.
